mechanism_claims.claim_text: Peptide 4 damages MRSA cell envelopes, with SEM/TEM evidence of depression/leakage at 1x MIC and collapse/lysis at 2x MIC after one hour.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct imaging supports membrane damage in MRSA; it does not by itself prove molecular insertion energetics.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Molecular dynamics simulations support interaction with an anionic POPG membrane model, including surface binding, penetration, membrane depression, and water-pore behavior during coarse-grained simulations.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Simulation evidence is mechanistic support, not a direct wet-lab mechanism assay.
